description: Use for: pulling repeated elements (prices, titles, links) from the page a session is on, via a CSS selector, or the full page text when no selector is given. Returns one string per matched element. Don't use when: the page has not been loaded yet — call browser_navigate first. Paid: $0.005 per call via x402 (Base USDC, Solana USDC, or XRPL XRP).

attribute.description: Attribute to read instead of text, e.g. href or src.

selector.description: CSS selector to extract. Omit for full page text.

session_id.description: Session ID. Reuse the same ID to keep cookies, login state and page position across calls; a new ID starts a fresh browser.

name: browser_extract
title: Extract data from the current page
